tasks.short: Explain safety procedures and demonstrate equipment use

steps.what: Explain the actual safety procedures in a form suitable for the passengers and transport equipment
inputs: approved safety procedures for the actual transport equipment
passengers' actual needs and questions

steps.what: Demonstrate actual safety equipment use, observe passenger understanding and address practical questions
inputs: actual approved safety equipment
safety explanation delivered to passengers
passengers' actual understanding and questions
outputs: actual safety demonstration and practical clarification delivered

tasks.design: Retain the direct explanation and equipment demonstration. Approved reference material in {DOCS} supports established procedures, but this scenario establishes no new reference-entry work or separate demonstration record to automate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Passengers need to understand actual equipment use, including practical questions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing approved instructions do not replace observing understanding or demonstrating equipment.
tasks.still_hard: Make the procedure clear for passengers with different needs.
tasks.human_edge: Notice confusion and demonstrate the actual equipment appropriately.

ambition.what: Keep direct safety explanation and demonstration.

build_days.consent_and_access: 0; no new system or passenger-data processing

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: passenger safety demonstrations require actual equipment explanation and adaptation to passenger questions.

assumptions: The task is the actual explanation and demonstration, not drafting a safety manual. No separate lookup, record write or message send is established; any actual local completion log must be decomposed before estimating it.

Native approved instruction cards or clips considered, but neither establishes understanding or replaces the required actual demonstration in this scenario. No administrative preparation share is invented.
Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Both steps fully retained, gross and net zero.
unknowns: Which parts require live demonstration and whether an actual completion record exists
research_questions: Observe explanation, demonstration and any actual record separately; can existing approved media help without replacing required live work?

already_counted.description: Demonstrate actual equipment and resolve understanding

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Actual required explanation and demonstration remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Signal transportation operators to stop or proceed

steps.what: Observe actual boarding, passenger movement and relevant stop/proceed conditions
inputs: actual passenger and transport conditions
approved signaling procedure
outputs: attendant's actual readiness and stop-condition observations

steps.what: Determine the correct stop or proceed signal for the actual operator and current conditions
inputs: attendant's actual readiness and stop-condition observations
actual intended operator and signaling procedure
outputs: attendant-selected exact signal and intended operator

steps.what: Give the selected stop or proceed signal to the intended transportation operator and observe acknowledgment
inputs: attendant-selected exact signal and intended operator
outputs: actual signal given and acknowledgment observed or unresolved

tasks.design: Retain direct observation, signal choice and physical signaling. Existing operating instructions in {DOCS} define the signaling convention; no timetable or sensor proxy establishes that actual passenger conditions permit proceeding.
tasks.previous_blocker: The signal depends on actual current conditions and an identified recipient.
tasks.enabler_now: No additional reliable input or control authority is established for automation.
tasks.still_hard: Recognize a changed condition immediately before signaling.
tasks.human_edge: Observe the real situation and communicate the right signal clearly.

ambition.what: Keep stop/proceed signaling with the attendant.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: transportation signaling depends on actual readiness observations and correct communication to the operator.

assumptions: Scenario is a direct signal to the operator in the same transport operation, not a software command. Gate represents the actual readiness/signal decision in s2, not an invented approval ceremony; any changed condition invalidates it.
Native signal hardware or approved convention is already the means. No separate signal record or report is established; nothing is folded into observation to hide a write.
Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. All work, including the actual signal, remains; gross and net zero.
unknowns: Actual signal convention, acknowledgment procedure and required live observations
research_questions: Observe the actual readiness decision and signal; is there any separate record or duplicated input?

already_counted.description: Determine the actual correct stop/proceed signal

approvals.approved_version: exact signal and operator selected at end of s2; changed conditions require a fresh decision

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Actual readiness observation, decision and signaling remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Respond to passenger questions, requests and complaints

steps.what: Listen to the passenger's actual question, request or complaint and clarify what help is needed
inputs: passenger's actual question, request or complaint

steps.what: Look up relevant actual journey status, service information or approved complaint procedure
inputs: attendant-understood passenger need
current operator-issued journey and service information
approved complaint procedure
outputs: attendant-checked applicable information and response limits

steps.what: Respond directly, provide permitted assistance and address actual follow-up questions or concerns
inputs: attendant-checked applicable information and response limits
passenger's actual response
outputs: actual passenger response and assistance outcome

steps.what: Complete and check an actual required complaint entry when this interaction requires one
inputs: attendant-understood passenger need
actual passenger response and assistance outcome
approved complaint procedure
outputs: complete checked complaint entry or explicit no-record-needed outcome

steps.what: Save the checked complaint entry in the same record only when required
inputs: complete checked complaint entry or explicit no-record-needed outcome
outputs: saved actual complaint entry or no write

tasks.design: Configure native links from {OPS_SYSTEM} journey status to approved service information in {DOCS}. The attendant checks current sources and responds directly; an actual required complaint entry in {HELPDESK} remains separate and fully retained.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant current service facts and procedure text can require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native service views and indexed procedure links can bring existing sources together.
tasks.still_hard: Understand the request and respond appropriately to a dissatisfied passenger.
tasks.human_edge: Listen and give useful help within actual authority.

ambition.what: Reduce source lookup without automatic complaint handling.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: passenger attendants use current service information and complaint procedures; indexed native source views can reduce lookup while personal assistance remains human.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is the operator's current journey/service information view; dispatch and service owners produce its data. DOCS holds approved procedures. No inferred live timetable or missing connection is invented.

Native links first. Scenario includes a small actual complaint-record component; ordinary questions have no record. Capture and save are retained, not a source of saving. No refund, booking change or escalation message is hidden in conversation.
Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios, not an asserted complaint frequency. Gross 6 minus 0.5 link upkeep gives 5.5 net; same-system complaint save is 1% fully retained.
unknowns: Current source freshness and actual complaint-record requirement
research_questions: Can native links reduce actual lookup while keeping disruption updates current and record ownership clear?

already_counted.description: Check actual service information before responding

incremental.description: Maintain source links and inspect stale-information cases

approvals.approved_version: complete complaint entry checked at end of s4; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if native source access already sufficient; cautious range below provisional 5.5% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Greet boarding passengers and announce routes and stops

steps.what: Greet actual boarding passengers and respond to immediate boarding needs
inputs: actual boarding passengers and needs
outputs: passengers greeted and immediate boarding contact made

steps.what: Check the actual route, next stop and any dispatch-issued changes
inputs: current operator-issued route, stop and service-change information
outputs: attendant-checked current route and stop facts

steps.what: Select and check the exact approved route/stop announcement, current context and intended passenger channel
inputs: attendant-checked current route and stop facts
existing approved recorded announcement clips and their exact transcripts
outputs: attendant-checked exact announcement clip and passenger channel, or manual fallback

steps.what: Broadcast the exact checked route or stop announcement to the intended passengers
inputs: attendant-checked exact announcement clip and passenger channel, or manual fallback
outputs: actual route or stop announcement heard over the passenger channel

tasks.design: Use approved recorded route/stop clips in the native passenger announcement function of {OPS_SYSTEM}. The attendant checks the current facts and exact clip before triggering it; greeting remains personal and an unmatched or changed announcement is spoken manually.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeatedly speaking standard route and stop announcements takes actual narration time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native recorded announcement playback can deliver an existing checked clip without repeated narration.
tasks.still_hard: Choose the correct current announcement and handle disruptions or passenger questions.
tasks.human_edge: Welcome passengers and recognize when the standard clip is wrong.

ambition.what: Reuse approved standard announcements while preserving personal greeting.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: passenger announcement systems can play approved prerecorded route and stop messages; staff still check context and handle nonstandard messages.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is the existing route/service view and passenger announcement system. Dispatch produces current route facts; the announcement owner already produced approved clips/transcripts. No new recording, generated speech or inferred vehicle location is hidden.

Native playback first, with a fresh exact-clip check in s3. The 31% scenario share represents today's actual repeated spoken narration, not a same-system send button or media runtime. If announcements already play natively or require live delivery, no saving.

Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 31 minus 1 trigger/fallback handling and 1 clip/version upkeep gives 29 net. Both new work items are focal hours per 100 baseline hours and counted once.
unknowns: Actual live narration duration, approved clip coverage and passenger-channel accessibility
research_questions: Can existing approved clips replace observed narration while retaining current-route checks and accessible manual fallback?

already_counted.description: Select and check exact announcement and current context

incremental.description: Trigger checked clips and handle playback/manual fallback failures
Maintain clip/transcript versions and route associations

approvals.approved_version: exact existing clip/transcript and passenger channel checked at end of s3 against current route facts; any change voids check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if already automated or standard playback unsuitable; cautious range below provisional 29% net for actual manual narration.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Dispatch and service owners supply current route facts; operators retain transport control authority.
skills_to_grow: Match exact announcement versions to actual route context
role.ambitious_version: Reduce verified lookup and repeated standard narration while preserving direct safety demonstration, signaling decisions and passenger care.
